pages.title: Bogey
pages.text:
A **bogey** is the wheel unit a train car rides on. Use Train Casing on a track to place one, and click the track again to cycle designs. Small and large bogeys exist.\
\
Blocks glued on top of bogeys become the car. Steam 'n' Rails adds many more bogey designs and other track gauges.
